List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. args.sql:
SELECT BowlerID
FROM bowlingleague.main.Bowler_Scores bs
JOIN bowlingleague.main.Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
JOIN bowlingleague.main.Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
WHERE bs.WonGame = 1
  AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
  AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
GROUP BY BowlerID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.TourneyLocation) = 3

WITH QualifiedBowlers AS (
    SELECT bs.BowlerID
    FROM bowlingleague.main.Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN bowlingleague.main.Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN bowlingleague.main.Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
      AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
    GROUP BY bs.BowlerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.TourneyLocation) = 3
)
SELECT 
    b.BowlerID,
    b.BowlerFirstName,
    b.BowlerLastName,
    bs.MatchID,
    bs.GameNumber,
    bs.HandiCapScore,
    t.TourneyDate,
    t.TourneyLocation
FROM bowlingleague.main.Bowler_Scores bs
JOIN bowlingleague.main.Bowlers b ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
JOIN bowlingleague.main.Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
JOIN bowlingleague.main.Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
JOIN QualifiedBowlers qb ON bs.BowlerID = qb.BowlerID
WHERE bs.WonGame = 1
  AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
  AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
